I really, really, really would like to recommend David Deutsch's book "The
Fabric of Reality". A book mostly about the "many worlds" interpretation of
quantum mechanics, written so well that a reasonably intelligent and
civilized person can understand it without a background in modern physics.

Seriously, it's mind blowing stuff. One of the chapters has an end summary:
"Summary: Time does not flow. Other times are just a special case of other
universes."

HG

P.S.
And it's available in Finnish as well. :-)
